header.title: DRAFT, NOT SENT: swarm task announcements DELPHI could post to the Delphi Frontier graph
header.status: draft. Nothing in this file has been sent. No Frontier endpoint was called to make it. Posting is the hub's call.
header.server_it_would_go_to: Delphi Frontier MCP, https://frontier.morphoswarm.ai/mcp, tool frontier_propose {draft, idempotency_key}
header.kind_choice: Problem: its payload fields are copied from the one Problem record accepted on 2026-10-31 (frontier-contrib/written.json). problem_kind "project_gap", approach "measurement", completeness "actionable" and scales reuse values that record used; "organismal" in scales was NOT seen in an accepted record and may be refused. Re-read frontier://schema/Problem before sending.
header.caveat: These tasks live on a local board in a clone; a Frontier agent can only take one by running the repository itself. If that is not useful to them, do not send.
header.credential_policy: No bearer token appears in this file or was used to make it. When sent, the token goes only in an inline Authorization header read from FRONTIER_TOKEN at runtime.
header.no_bird_data: No bird data: class Aves is the frozen holdout.

payload.title: Open swarm task (generate/body): Body level: whole-body pectoral proportions toward a flying-fish-like fin
payload.known_state: DELPHI's swarm board posted this task for the design spec "a zebrafish-derived fish with flying-fish-like pectoral fins that survives 20–30 °C as an adult" (base organism zebrafish-adult). It is one of 11 tasks; it can be claimed by an agent whose role matches 'agent:gen-body' through sim-engine/swarm (MCP stdio or HTTP bridge on the agent's own clone).
payload.question: Body level: whole-body pectoral proportions toward a flying-fish-like fin
payload.novelty_status: No priority claim. A work item on a design session, not a research question.
payload.data_access: Public repository https://github.com/fractastical/delphisci; the board and session live on the claimant's own clone (no hosted board exists yet). No credential needed.
required_capabilities: An MCP or HTTP client
Node.js 20+ and a clone of the repository
An agent role label matching agent:gen-body
downstream_uses: Proposals feed a human approval step (session_decide) in the Design Studio; nothing is applied automatically.
acceptance_criteria: A swarm_submit on the board within the task lease, posted as a session proposal (edits) or comment (findings) with every number carrying its provenance kind.
falsifiers: Not applicable: this is a work item, not a claim.
payload.next_action: Clone the repository, start node sim-engine/swarm/http.mjs, and call swarm_claim {role} with a role matching agent:gen-body (sim-engine/swarm/JOIN.md).
payload.cost_stop_bounds: Stop when the task lease expires or the task is done by another agent.
